messages:
sara-sales: Hey team — presales sync for Acme Health POC. They want region pinning to EU (Frankfurt) + Canada, and need a list of sub-processors touching egress. Also asking if we can enforce service-account-level egress consent for their tenant. Any blockers?

anya-solutions: Quick Q — is the ask strict geo for model execution, or just egress/data-at-rest? customer said 'all inference stays in-region' in the SQA.

sara-sales: They wrote 'inference and model KV/cache must not leave region; control plane ok', so runtime pinned.

leo-ops: Practically we can pin tenant to region pools (Dedicated or Private). For Hosted there's a regional endpoint but fallback can route to other regions on capacity — need to mark as non-fallback for strict residency. That impacts SLA/cost.

mike-legal: From compliance side we need full sub-processor list for the FR region + Canada and whether any third-party CDNs / analytics receive logs. They also asked for certs (SOC2 + EU DPA).

anya-solutions: On the service-account egress consent: we have per-tenant routing tags and we can require a tenant flag that prevents cross-region egress. We don't have per-service-account egress popups, but we can scope service accounts to tenant routing policies. Is that sufficient for them?

frank-cto: If they require zero cross-region replication of KV cache, we'll need Private or Dedicated with cache isolation. Hosted with prefix caching may still replicate. Important: quantify perf cost and incremental ops time.

leo-ops: Notes: to support strict pinning we must do 3 things: 1) configure tenant routing to region (no failover allowed), 2) deploy model variant in target region(s), 3) lock KV cache replication off for that tenant. Ops estimate: 2-4 days for preflight and infra change, plus SLA upgrade.

deploy-bot: deploy:tenant-routing: scheduled job queued for tenant-acme-proj to apply region_pin=eu-central-1 at 2025-10-12T09:00:00Z (dry-run).

mike-legal: Also need written attestation on sub-processors. Can ops export a minimal subproc CSV? We should mark which processors handle egress metadata vs payload.

leo-ops: I'll generate subproc list: cloud-hosting (eu-central-1), monitoring (datadog eu), KMS provider (customer BYOK or our kms-eu), CDN (none for inference), logging (internal aggregators in-region only). I can attach a short bullet list after this thread.

anya-solutions: Pricing impact: strict no-failover + dedicated replicas = +25-40% estimated cost vs cross-region pooling. Need to surface to AE.

sara-sales: Good — can we confirm BYOK options? Customer will insist on their KMS in EU and key never leaves region.

leo-ops: We support BYOK for Private and Dedicated. For Hosted we support BYOK with region-restricted KMS in Europe but need to confirm HSM/HSM-backed options. Ops to confirm with infra.

mike-legal: I'll send their SQA back with the subproc CSV and an ask for SOC2 + DPA copy. We should include a sentence about 'no cross-region KV replication for pinned tenants' in the DPA addendum.

frank-cto: Ops + Legal — include a short runbook for on-call if region capacity drops and we can't failover (what to do: throttling policy, customer notification, escalation).

anya-solutions: I'll draft a one-pager: 1) behaviors (pinning semantics), 2) subproc list, 3) BYOK options, 4) pricing delta, 5) runbook. Target delivery: EOD tomorrow.

sara-sales: Perfect. AE + customer call scheduled Thursday 10:30am PT. @anya-solutions please bring the one-pager. :thumbsup:

leo-ops: Action items assigned: leo-ops -> subproc CSV & infra notes (tomorrow AM); anya -> one-pager; mike-legal -> DPA addendum language; frank -> cost delta sign-off.

sara-sales: Thanks all — keeping this thread concise for the deal doc.
